gloss_en: Link IFC in Revit 2025-2027 puts the building too high and levels at double the elevation; Open IFC handles it better.

phrasing_notes: bug template, compares Revit versions, screenshots

phrasing_notes: very short, attaches zip
answer_summary: Maintainer reproduced it; Open IFC works on the same file; logged internally as open.

gloss_en: Open IFC and Link IFC give very different results: Open makes in-place families without IFC data, Link imports assemblies plus their parts.

phrasing_notes: polite, asks for an official word
answer_summary: Open and Link are separate code paths; roadmap is to move both reference and design-transfer workflows onto the newer Link code.

gloss_en: Export lets you choose the origin but import always uses the internal origin; can import use the project base point?

question_paraphrase: Export offers internal origin, survey point or PBP; import offers nothing; cites an old Revit Ideas post saying it is not possible.
phrasing_notes: cites forum link, general complaint
answer_summary: Supported for Link IFC from Revit 2026: Positioning option (Internal Origin, Project Base Point, Survey Point) plus orientation.

gloss_en: Georeferenced IFCs line up in Trimble and BIM Vision but not when linked in Revit 2022; is there an easy way?

phrasing_notes: friendly opener, non-native English
answer_summary: Match project coordinates before linking, ask authors to export in your coordinates, or fix coordinates with third-party tools (painful on every update).

gloss_en: A linked MEP IFC loses many entities in Revit 2023 versus 2021; log shows DirectShapeType validation errors; fine in Solibri.

phrasing_notes: pastes log line, wry tone

gloss_en: The same IFC linked in Revit 2020 sits near the origin, in 2021 far away and distorted.

answer_summary: Autodesk said linking was improved and asked for a sample file.

gloss_en: An IFC with large coordinates links centered in Revit 2023 but in 2024 the selection box stretches to zero and geometry breaks.
